subject: Post-demo: Proof-of-Value plan, success metrics & owner assignments
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@aquanetics.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@aquanetics.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks — next steps for PoV

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team at AquaNetics liked the latency profile and the KV cache examples. A few quick items we discussed and want to confirm before we kick off a short proof-of-value: 

- Success criteria: 95th perc latency under 220ms for the search assistant, and embedding recall >= 0.82 on our Q1 prompt set.
- Data scope: subset of product queries (last 90 days) + synthetic prompts you suggested for edge cases.
- Timeline: 3 weeks active evaluation, plus 1 week buffer for onboarding issues.

Can you send a one-page plan with owners (infra, app, security, procurement) so we can route approvals? Procurement will need estimated TCO for a 3-week Dedicated test.

Thanks,
Tom

--
Tom Ellis
Head of Product
AquaNetics Inc
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@aquanetics.com>, Priya Rao <priya@aquanetics.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks — next steps for PoV

Tom — great to hear. Attaching a short Proof-of-Value (PoV) packet: PoV_RACI spreadsheet and a one-page activation checklist. High level below so procurement can start their work.

PoV at-a-glance:
- Objective: Validate retrieval/embedding accuracy and production-like latency on a representative subset.
- Duration: 3 weeks active + 1 week buffer (4 weeks total).
- Key success metrics: 95th <= 220ms (gen path), embedding recall >= 0.82 (top-5).
- Expected infra: Dedicated small GPU pool (2x A10s equivalent) for parallel sessions — cost estimate included in attached sheet.

Owner assignments (proposed):
- Infra owner: Aditya Rao — responsible for Dedicated pool setup, access, and VPN/peering.
- App owner: Monica Patel — integration of inference API into your staging assistant and run small regression tests.
- Security lead (Redwood contact): Laura Bennett — SOC/traffic encryption, data retention config, and narrow-scoped audit logs.
- Procurement contact (AquaNetics): Tom / Priya — purchase approval and payment terms.

Next steps:
1) Aditya will schedule a 30-min infra kickoff to exchange network details and test VM/SFTP access by Monday.
2) Monica will send the integration sample code and a short checklist for the test harness.
3) Laura will share the minimal security questionnaire answers and recommended retention policy (14 days).
4) Tom/Priya to review and confirm procurement window by EOD Monday so we can reserve capacity.

I'll set up a shared Drive folder and add the RACI and checklist now.

Best,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks — looping in infra details. Tom/Priya: I can provision the Dedicated pool and set up a temporary VPC peering for your staging environment. Items I need from you to start:
- CIDR range for the staging VPC.
- IP allowlist for any management hosts (CI, SRE IPs).
- A contact for SSH key exchange and SFTP account for sample dataset ingest.

Estimated lead times:
- Capacity reservation & basic networking: 48 hours after we have the CIDR and allowlist.
- Full test harness connectivity (SFTP + API keys): ~72 hours including DNS and egress rules.

On retention: we recommend 14-day ephemeral retention for the PoV; if you need logs longer we can export to your bucket.

I'll schedule the infra kickoff for Monday 10:00am PT unless you prefer another time.

- Aditya

Priya / Marcus / Tom — noted. I'll attach the security snapshot and the minimal SOC2-derived checklist to the Drive folder (redwood-pov-checklist.pdf) and include the retention settings we recommend. Quick clarifications:
- Audit logs: We'll provide request-level logs for the 4-week window and an export option to your S3 bucket.
- Data handling: Raw query content will be isolated to the Dedicated pool and wiped after the retention window unless you request an export.
